beats.headline: Mogul buys the old Starlight fairground
beats.body: The owner of the roadside car wash and Willowbrook's farm has bought the Starlight fairground, closed these twenty years. The ticket booth is open again and the old carousel has had a fresh coat of paint.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: I rode that carousel when I was six. Sell the tickets, fill the horses, and make it spin again.

beats.headline: Carousel turns again after 20 years
beats.body: Every horse was taken when the Starlight carousel went round today, to cheers from the crowd. A full ride pays every seat, and a little more besides.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Full house! Let it fill when there's a crowd. When it's quiet, pull the lever and keep the line moving.

beats.headline: Candy floss is back at Starlight
beats.body: A pink candy floss cart has opened by the carousel, and it's already the most popular spot in the park after the horses.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Children won't leave a fair without something sweet. Keep that cart busy.

beats.headline: Bumper cars crash into Starlight
beats.body: Six bright bumper cars have opened on the Midway, and the queue for them is already round the corner. Riders say the bumping is the best part.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: The Midway's open! Launch the cars when they're full, and listen for the crashes.

beats.headline: Supply truck rolls into Starlight
beats.body: A delivery truck now brings sugar, buns and prizes to the park's new supply shed. Stall holders say they'll never run short again, as long as someone carries the boxes over.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Pick up the boxes at the shed's door and take them behind the stalls. An empty stall sells nothing.

beats.headline: Starlight hires its first ride operator
beats.body: The fairground has a ride operator again. The carousel now runs itself: full loads go at once, and nobody waits too long for a partial one.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: That's the park finding its feet: the rides run themselves now. Keep an eye on them, mind. That machinery is old.

beats.headline: Old ride gives up, mogul grabs a wrench
beats.body: One of Starlight's rides ground to a halt today with a bang and a puff of smoke, to gasps from the queue. The owner was seen rolling up his sleeves.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: These old rides wear out. Stand at the lever with a spanner and it'll run again. A mechanic would save you the trouble.

beats.headline: Teacups spin again at Starlight
beats.body: Four giant teacups are spinning in Kiddie Corner, and the children can't get enough of them. Families are coming from all over town.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Two rides in Kiddie Corner now. One operator can run them both if they're quick on their feet.

beats.headline: Starlight's paths spotless again
beats.body: Bright new bins line the paths at Starlight Fun Park, and a janitor sweeps up after the crowds. Visitors say it's the cleanest fair they've been to.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: A tidy park keeps folk smiling. Next: the lake, and the evenings.
